us_name: [CF] Rename CF related models (DM_related to DM_dsr)
module: CF related model rename DM_*_related → DM_*_dsr + 8 persisted queries (DSR-669) – CF layer 1.0–8.0, 10.0 · Page layer 9.0, 11.0–16.0

tcs.summary: EN: Verify the 3 CF related models exist as DM_movie_dsr / DM_product_dsr / DM_catalog_dsr (node name and jcr:title). JP: CF関連モデル3つがDM_*_dsr（ノード名・jcr:title）で存在することを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: Author cookie valid (tools/author probe.sh check 1 = 200). JP: Authorクッキー有効。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Read-only: node tools/author/author.mjs models (CF OpenAPI /adobe/sites/cf/models). 2. For each of movie/product/catalog read model path /conf/ykk/settings/dam/cfm/models/dm_<type>_dsr and its title. JP: 1. モデル一覧を取得。2. 各モデルのパス・タイトルを確認。
tcs.expected: EN: Exactly 3 models: path …/models/dm_movie_dsr, dm_product_dsr, dm_catalog_dsr; title = DM_movie_dsr, DM_product_dsr, DM_catalog_dsr. JP: 3モデルが上記パス・タイトルで存在。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify no model DM_movie_related / DM_product_related / DM_catalog_related remains (negative). JP: 旧モデルDM_*_relatedが残っていないことを確認する（ネガティブ）。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Model list (1.0 step 1). 2. GET model path …/models/dm_<type>_related for movie/product/catalog. JP: モデル一覧と旧パスを確認。
tcs.expected: EN: No model titled or named *_related in the list; the 3 old model paths return 404 (or are absent). JP: *_relatedモデルなし、旧パス404。

tcs.feature: Every DSR CF migrated to the new model (CFREN-003)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify every CF under /content/dam/dsr/{lang}/ (incl. sub-folders) points to a DM_*_dsr model (cq:model), none to an old path. JP: /content/dam/dsr/{lang}/配下（サブフォルダ含む）の全CFがDM_*_dsrモデルを参照することを確認する。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. List recursively /content/dam/dsr/{ja,en}/movies/standard, products, catalogs (all pages, not only first 50). 2. For each CF read its model path. 3. Count by model. JP: 再帰的に全CFのモデルを集計。
tcs.expected: EN: 100% of CFs: movies/standard → DM_movie_dsr, products → DM_product_dsr, catalogs → DM_catalog_dsr; 0 CF on dm_*_related. Boundary: sub-folder CFs (dsr/ja/products/qa586/990586006, dsr/*/movies/standard/qa587/qa587-sub) are included and migrated. Total ≥ 84 (Martin report 23/10). JP: 全CF新モデル、旧モデル0件、サブフォルダ含む。
tcs.design: DSR-669 Scope #2 · AC1 · Martin migration report 23/10 16:15

tcs.summary: EN: Verify DM_movie / DM_product / DM_catalog keep their names and every CF under /content/dam/common/{lang}/ still uses them. JP: CFコミューンのモデル名が変わらず、common配下のCFが同モデルを使うことを確認する。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Model list. 2. Count models of CFs under /content/dam/common/{ja,en}/{movies,products,catalogs}. JP: モデル一覧とcommon配下CFのモデルを集計。
tcs.expected: EN: Models DM_movie, DM_product, DM_catalog exist with unchanged paths (dm_movie, dm_product, dm_catalog); every common CF uses the matching model; no common CF uses a *_dsr model. JP: 名称不変、common CFは対応モデルのみ。

tcs.feature: Only DM_*_dsr can be created under /content/dam/dsr (CFREN-005)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify the Create Content Fragment dialog under each /content/dam/dsr/{lang}/ folder offers only the matching DM_*_dsr model. JP: dsr配下のフォルダでCF作成時、対応するDM_*_dsrモデルのみ選択できることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: Author DEV, user Agent QA (lane chrome) or QA-PT. Do NOT finish the creation. JP: 作成は完了しない。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open https://author-p192812-e2014374.adobeaemcloud.com/assets.html/content/dam/dsr/ja/products → Create → Content Fragment. 2. Note every model offered, then Cancel. 3. Repeat for /dsr/ja/catalogs, /dsr/ja/movies/standard and the en folders. JP: 各フォルダで作成ダイアログのモデル一覧を記録し、キャンセル。
tcs.expected: EN: products → only DM_product_dsr; catalogs → only DM_catalog_dsr; movies/standard → only DM_movie_dsr. Not offered (negative): any DM_*_related, DM_movie/DM_product/DM_catalog, DM_techmovie_dsr. Screenshot of each dialog. JP: 各フォルダで対応モデルのみ。旧モデル・コミューンモデルは表示されない。
tcs.design: DSR-669 Scope #3 · AC2 (+ DSR-670 policy movies/standard)

tcs.feature: Existing CF related opens and saves (CFREN-006)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify a migrated QA CF related of each type opens in the CF editor without error and saves. JP: 移行済みのQA用CF関連（各タイプ）がCFエディタで開け、保存できることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-669-04 (QA CFs only). JP: QA用CFのみ。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open in CF editor: dsr/ja/movies/standard/qa587-main, dsr/ja/products/990586001, dsr/ja/catalogs/qa190-cat-pdf. 2. Check the form loads with current values. 3. Click Save without changing any value. JP: 3CFを開き、値を変えずに保存。
tcs.expected: EN: Each editor opens with all fields filled as before (movie / product / catalog reference not empty, isActive unchanged); Save succeeds with no error toast; Author read-back shows unchanged values. JP: エラーなく開き、保存成功、値は不変。

tcs.feature: Label autofill still works after rename (CFREN-007)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify picking the referenced CF commune still fills the display label (movieLabel / productLabel) in a DM_*_dsr CF. JP: DM_*_dsr CFで参照先を選ぶと表示ラベル（movieLabel/productLabel）が自動入力されることを確認する。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open dsr/ja/movies/standard/qa587-main in CF editor. 2. Re-pick the movie reference (same CF /content/dam/common/ja/movies/qa587-main). 3. Read movieLabel. 4. Do the same for product 990586001. 5. Save. JP: 参照を選び直し、ラベルを確認、保存。
tcs.expected: EN: movieLabel is filled automatically, not empty, with the referenced movie's id and title separated by full-width ｜. productLabel is filled automatically (exact format = DSR-671 TC; this TC only checks autofill still fires). JP: ラベルが自動入力される（空でない）。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify a DM_*_dsr CF with isBoothLimited = true and empty dsrFeatures cannot be saved (negative). JP: isBoothLimited=trueでdsrFeatures未入力のDM_*_dsr CFが保存できないことを確認する（ネガティブ）。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-669-04. Revert rule in TestData How-to step 4. JP: 元に戻す手順あり。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open dsr/ja/movies/standard/qa587-main. 2. Check dsrFeatures is empty. 3. Turn ブース限定掲載 (isBoothLimited) ON. 4. Click Save. 5. Turn it OFF again; close without saving. JP: ブース限定ONで保存を試み、OFFに戻す。
tcs.expected: EN: Save is refused with a message that DSR掲載ブース (dsrFeatures) is required; the stored CF keeps isBoothLimited = false (Author read-back). JP: 保存不可・必須メッセージ、保存値はfalseのまま。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify the 8 persisted queries return HTTP 200 with data and no GraphQL error on DEV publish. JP: 8つの永続クエリがDEV PublishでHTTP 200・データあり・GraphQLエラーなしを返すことを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-669-01 published. JP: TD-669-01公開済み。
tcs.steps: EN: GET https://publish-p192812-e2014374.adobeaemcloud.com/graphql/execute.json/ykk/<query>;<params> for: dsr-video-page;path=/content/dam/dsr/ja/movies/standard/qa587-main · dsr-video-list (ja) · video-detail (qa587-main) · dsr-product-page;path=/content/dam/dsr/ja/products/990586001 · dsr-product-list (ja) · product-detail (990586001) · dsr-catalog-page;path=/content/dam/dsr/ja/catalogs/qa190-cat-pdf · dsr-catalog-list (ja). Repeat en. JP: 8クエリをja/enで取得。
tcs.expected: EN: 8/8 HTTP 200, JSON has data and no `errors` key; *-page queries return aliases `related` and `inactive`; *-list return alias `related` with ≥ 1 item; the QA item is present. JP: 全て200、errorsなし、エイリアスrelated/inactiveあり。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify no persisted query in the ykk configuration still refers to dmMovieRelatedList / dmProductRelatedList / dmCatalogRelatedList (negative). JP: ykk設定の永続クエリにdm*RelatedListが残っていないことを確認する（ネガティブ）。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Read-only GET https://author-p192812-e2014374.adobeaemcloud.com/graphql/list.json/ykk (persisted query list with query text). 2. Search every query text for 'RelatedList' and 'dm_movie_related|dm_product_related|dm_catalog_related'. JP: クエリ一覧を取得し文字列検索。
tcs.expected: EN: 0 matches. The 8 queries of 9.0 are in the list and read dm*DsrList. If list.json is not reachable → Pending with the HTTP status (not Fail). JP: 0件。

tcs.feature: Delivered JS has no old names (CFREN-011)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify the delivered EDS code (product-detail, video-detail, related-product, catalog-detail) contains no dm_*_related / dm*RelatedList string. JP: 配信中のEDSコードにdm_*_related / dm*RelatedListが含まれないことを確認する。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. GET https://main--dsr-eds-dev--sutrix-projects.aem.live/blocks/product-detail/product-detail.js, /blocks/video-detail/video-detail.js, /blocks/catalog-detail/catalog-detail.js, /blocks/related-product/related-product.js. 2. Search for 'Related' list names and '_related'. 3. Open /ja/products/990586001 and /ja/library/video/qa587-main with network log. JP: JSを取得して検索、ページのネットワークを記録。
tcs.expected: EN: 0 occurrences of dmMovieRelatedList / dmProductRelatedList / dmCatalogRelatedList / dm_*_related in the files; no browser request to a *-related* persisted query. JP: 0件、旧クエリへの通信なし。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify the video, product and catalog detail overlay pages show the same data as before the rename. JP: 改名後も動画・製品・カタログ詳細オーバーレイページが改名前と同じデータを表示することを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: Pre-669 snapshot results/JOB-20261023-07/overlay-before-669.json. JP: 改名前スナップショット。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Run the overlay specs used in JOB-20261023-07 (movie-detail DSR-587, product-detail DSR-586, catalog-overlay DSR-654) on DEV. 2. Compare test-by-test with overlay-before-669.json. JP: 同じスペックを実行し、結果を比較。
tcs.expected: EN: Every test that passed before passes now (0 NEW FAIL); page content (title, rows, related items) for qa587-main, 990586001, qa190-cat-pdf equals the snapshot. Differences caused by data edited after 23/10 are listed, not failed. JP: 以前Passのテストは全てPass、内容一致。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify the video, product and catalog lists show the same items as before the rename. JP: 改名後も動画・製品・カタログ一覧が改名前と同じ項目を表示することを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: Pre-669 regression ledger results/REGRESSION/ledger.json. JP: 改名前の回帰台帳。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Open https://main--dsr-eds-dev--sutrix-projects.aem.live/ja/library/video/search, /ja/library/catalog, the product list (fixtures/paths.ts) for ja and en. 2. Count cards and collect ids. 3. Compare with the last pre-669 regression run. JP: 一覧のカード数とIDを比較。
tcs.expected: EN: Same card count and same ids as the pre-669 run per list and language; no 'Unable to load' message; every card links to a 200 detail page. JP: カード数・ID一致、エラーなし、リンク200。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify a DSR CF with isActive = false is still returned under alias `inactive` and its page keeps the inactive behaviour (boundary). JP: isActive=falseのDSR CFがエイリアスinactiveで返り、ページの非表示挙動が変わらないことを確認する（境界）。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-669-01 inactive product 990586008 (ja). JP: TD-669-01。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. GET https://publish-p192812-e2014374.adobeaemcloud.com/graphql/execute.json/ykk/dsr-product-page;path=/content/dam/dsr/ja/products/990586008. 2. Open https://main--dsr-eds-dev--sutrix-projects.aem.live/ja/products/990586008 in a browser. JP: クエリとページを確認。
tcs.expected: EN: Query: item under `inactive` (isActive false), HTTP 200, no error. Page: same behaviour as before 669 (KNOWN-FACTS 22/10: 200 + unavailable row, browser redirects to list; robots noindex). JP: inactiveに返る、ページ挙動は改名前と同じ。

tcs.summary: EN: Verify republishing an existing CF related of each type (video, product, catalog) regenerates its overlay page with the same content. JP: 既存のCF関連（動画・製品・カタログ）を再公開するとオーバーレイページが同じ内容で再生成されることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-669-02 republish done (time recorded). Tech talk → DSR-670 TC 7.0. JP: TD-669-02再公開済み。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. Before: save HTML of https://main--dsr-eds-dev--sutrix-projects.aem.live/en/library/video/qa587-main, /ja/products/990586001, /ja/library/catalog/qa190-cat-pdf. 2. Lane author republishes the 3 DSR CFs (TD-669-02). 3. After ≥ 5 min: fetch again, read Last-Modified. JP: 再公開前後のHTMLを比較。
tcs.expected: EN: Each page: Last-Modified later than the republish time; HTTP 200; main content (title, rows, related) identical to before. JP: Last-Modifiedが再公開後、内容一致。

tcs.feature: New DSR CF after rename generates its page (CFREN-016)
tcs.summary: EN: Verify a new DSR CF created on DM_catalog_dsr after the rename and published gets its overlay page. JP: 改名後に新規作成・公開したDM_catalog_dsr CFのオーバーレイページが生成されることを確認する。
tcs.pre: EN: TD-669-03 qa669-new published (content CF + DSR CF). JP: TD-669-03公開済み。
tcs.steps: EN: 1. GET https://main--dsr-eds-dev--sutrix-projects.aem.live/ja/library/catalog/qa669-new. 2. GET https://publish-p192812-e2014374.adobeaemcloud.com/graphql/execute.json/ykk/dsr-catalog-page;path=/content/dam/dsr/ja/catalogs/qa669-new. JP: ページとクエリを取得。
tcs.expected: EN: Page HTTP 200 with catalog title 'QA669 new catalog'; query returns the item under `related` with model DM_catalog_dsr. JP: 200・タイトル表示、クエリでrelatedに返る。

assumptions: Baseline BL-669-1 = DSR-669 description (Scope + Acceptance criteria, Jira 23/10) + Martin migration report 23/10 16:15 VN (KNOWN-FACTS: 84 DSR CF migrated, 78 live republished, 6 not-live skipped, 55 overlay pages regenerated).

[Giả định] 'Same data as before' oracle = pre-deploy overlay run results/JOB-20261023-07/overlay-before-669.json + last pre-669 regression ledger entry. Differences caused by CFs edited after 23/10 are reported, not failed.
Tech talk part of AC5 ('republish each type … tech talk') is covered by the DSR-670 TC file (DEV has no tech-talk CF on 24/10).
The 6 not-live CFs skipped by the migration republish are not expected to have a .live page; 3.0 still expects their model migrated.

[Giả định] AC 'No dm_*_related reference left in either repo': QA has no access to dsr-fullstack / dsr-eds repos → verified indirectly on delivered assets (11.0) and persisted query list (10.0). Repo grep = dev responsibility.
Automation is read-only (Author GET via tools/author with cookie; publish GET). Writes (republish, new CF, booth-rule try) only by lane author/chrome on QA-owned CFs; never touch non-QA CFs.
ja/catalogs/catalogid-01 still 404 on live (Martin report) is non-QA data → excluded from 12.0/13.0.
cn: no /cn site on DEV (Issue #18) → Language ja, en only.
